summary.text: Steve Byers is the Republican candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the August 18 Republican primary.
Ballotpedia lists him as the 2022 Republican nominee for Florida State Senate District 26, a race he lost to incumbent Lori Berman.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Byers described himself as a serial entrepreneur and a homeschooling parent who is not a career politician.

He said he studied computer engineering in college, worked for Bell Northern Research, and later ran a technology consulting business before developing businesses in aviation, real estate, education, beekeeping and insurance.
Byers defeated William Wheelen in the August 23, 2022 Republican primary for Florida State Senate District 26, then lost the November 8, 2022 general election to Lori Berman.
His 2022 survey named election integrity and parents' control over education among his key messages.
